commitResults.messageTitle: Add Level-1: Echo user commands until bye
Add Level-2: Store and list items
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace the echo behaviour with storage: any input that is not a known
command is kept in a fixed-size String[100] and confirmed with 'added: X',
and the 'list' command prints the collection numbered from 1. The brief
allows assuming at most 100 items, so a fixed array plus an item count is
sufficient and avoids introducing collections before the course covers them.

Pass the array and count as method parameters rather than making them static
fields, so each print method declares what it depends on. Guard the 101st
item with an in-character message instead of letting the array index throw.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Level-3: Mark tasks as done, extract Task class
commitResults.messageBody:
Add 'mark <n>' and 'unmark <n>' so the user can track which tasks are
finished, and show each task's status as [X] or [ ] in the list.

Extract a Task class into its own file (A-Classes) to hold the description
and done flag together, replacing the parallel String array. Fields are
protected rather than private so later increments can add specialised task
types that inherit from it. Task.toString() renders the status box so the
list and the mark/unmark confirmations share one format.

Guard against a missing, non-numeric, or out-of-range task number so a
mistyped command reports the problem instead of throwing.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add A-CodingStandard: Adopt the SE-EDU Java coding standard
commitResults.messageBody:
Review the code against the intermediate-level SE-EDU Java coding standard
and fix two violations: rename the command constants so related constants
share a common prefix (COMMAND_MARK, COMMAND_UNMARK) as the grouping rule
requires, and replace the unexplained two-space literal in
printStatusChanged with the named INDENT_DETAIL constant.

Record the standard in AGENTS.md so it binds all future code rather than
being a one-off cleanup, along with the points that recur in this project.
Document the default-package deviation as deliberate: the standard requires
every class to belong to a package, but the course introduces packages in
the later A-Packages increment.

No behaviour change; the Level-3 scenarios produce identical output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Level-4: ToDos, Deadlines and Events
commitResults.messageBody:
Add three task types as subclasses of Task: Todo has no date, Deadline
carries a /by time, and Event carries /from and /to times. Each overrides
toString() to prepend its type tag and delegates to super.toString() for the
status box, so the shared display format stays in one place.

Add the todo, deadline and event commands, splitting input on the /by, /from
and /to markers. Report a problem when a description or time is missing
rather than storing an incomplete task.

Bare text no longer adds a task, since every task now displays a type tag
and an untagged Task would break the list format; unrecognised input now
reports the commands Floppy understands.

Pluralise task counts correctly and show worked examples of the three new
commands in the greeting, as their syntax is not guessable.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract command dispatch out of main
commitResults.messageBody:
main was 37 lines and mixed two levels of abstraction: high-level
orchestration (greet, loop, farewell) sat directly beside low-level string
comparisons deciding which command the user typed. That violates the Single
Level of Abstraction Principle and pushed the method past the 30-line
readability guideline.

Move the if-else dispatch chain into a new handleCommand method that returns
the updated task count. main now reads as three steps at one level -- greet,
handle one command per line until bye, say farewell -- and no longer needs to
know which commands exist.

No behaviour change.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task lookup out of changeTaskStatus
commitResults.messageBody:
changeTaskStatus was 31 lines and did three separate jobs: pull the task
number out of the input, validate it against the stored tasks, then mutate
and report. Splitting a string and calling Integer.parseInt sat directly
beside task.markAsDone(), mixing levels of abstraction in one method.

Move the parsing and validation into a new findTask method that returns the
task the user picked, or null after reporting why it could not be found.
changeTaskStatus now asks which task is meant and acts on the answer, which
brings it to 15 lines.

This also makes the lookup consistent with createTodo, createDeadline and
createEvent, which already report a problem and return null, so the two
kinds of failure now look the same to a reader.

No behaviour change.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use a guard clause for the empty task list
commitResults.messageBody:
printTasks hid its main path inside an else. The empty case now returns
early so the listing reads straight down.

commitResults.messageTitle: Report huge task numbers as out of range
commitResults.messageBody:
A number too large for int was reported as 'not a number', which is wrong.
It is a number, just not one that names a task.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add FloppyException and use it for the add commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Error detection and reporting were tangled together in each creator, which
signalled failure by returning null. One catch in main now reports them.

commitResults.messageTitle: Throw from the task lookup instead of returning null
commitResults.messageBody:
findTask reported problems itself and returned null, so callers had to
remember a null check. It now throws and changeTaskStatus lost that check.

commitResults.messageTitle: Route the remaining errors through FloppyException
commitResults.messageBody:
Unknown commands, list with an argument, and a full disk each printed their
own message. All errors now report from one place, so two printers went away.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move classes into floppy and floppy.task packages
commitResults.messageBody:
The coding standard requires every class to belong to a package. The Task
hierarchy is the one real grouping among the six classes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update docs for the new package layout
commitResults.messageBody:
The README pointed at the old file location, and AGENTS.md recorded the
default package as a known deviation that A-Packages has now resolved.
